visual_thesis: Distinguish protected internal reasoning from final public answers. Request and output checks plus campaign investigation reinforce one another; internal adaptive tests do not guarantee security.
mechanism_metaphor: One continuous technical cutaway: an incoming request ribbon reaches a layered model enclosure. Inside are a deep opaque protected reasoning core, a trained-response layer, separate assistant-message and tool-argument channels and a narrow output screening membrane. A clean final-answer strip exits. An attempted extraction strip visibly stops at the protected inner core with a flat terminal edge, never a success mark. Above, grouped request traces are tied by headless evidence lines to a campaign inspection lens. Twelve meaningful components: request ribbon, extraction strip, trained-response layer, protected core, assistant channel, tool-argument channel, output screening membrane, answer strip, grouped account traces, evidence ties, investigation lens and detached adaptive-test specimen. No invented circuit, literal hidden reasoning, shield, lock or numerical gauge. The answer strip bears Final answer; the inner core bears Protected reasoning; the tool channel bears Tool arguments. No anonymous record surfaces.
